description: This PHP file defines the 'ScreenPermission' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing permissions related to screens within the application. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to the database, including properties for read, create, update, delete permissions, and relationships to 'UserRole' and 'Screen' entities.

classes.name: ScreenPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permissions for a specific screen within the OrangeHRM system, including read, create, update, delete rights, and associations with UserRole and Screen entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the ScreenPermission entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the ScreenPermission entity.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether the read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether the create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether the update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether the delete permission is granted.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole with this permission.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Associates a Screen with this permission.
